Latin word

īnferō

īnferō, īnferre, intulī, illātum

verb, irregular (a compound of ferō); with in and the accusative, ad, or the dative, conjugation

carry or bring into; bring upon, inflict

In this lexicon

  • carry in

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fam. 15.2.1: bellō in prōvinciam illātō (Lewis & Short); Cic. Att. 9.1.3: bellum Ītaliae (Lewis & Short); Liv. 32.24.5: scālās ad moenia (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • īnferrī mēnsam secundam jussī

    I ordered the second course to be brought inPlin. NH 9.120 (Lewis & Short)
